text:
Alex: quick heads-up — ran the kb link-scan on staging, found a few small oddities: 3 redirects in /docs/ja/ (two shortlinks and one old canonical) + a dead diagram in /docs/runtime/kv-cache.md. Not blocking but would like a tiny sweep.

Alex: paths I saw:
- /docs/ja/onboarding/quickstart (shortlink -> 404)
- /docs/ja/faq/cache-behavior (redirect loop)
- /docs/ja/models/compat (old canonical -> legacy)
- /docs/runtime/kv-cache.md (diagram.svg is a gdrive link 403)

Alex: quick repro commands:
```
# ripgrep locally against the snapshot
rg "gdrive|shortlink|redirect" content/ | head

# curl the bad svg
curl -I "https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=XXX"
```

Alex: who can take the ja redirects? @Maria — any chance you can claim? :wave:

Maria: I can take the ja ones. will rehost any images and replace shortlinks with canonical paths. aiming to open PR in the morning.

Alex: awesome, thanks. ping me in the PR for a quick review. please add `docs:quick-fix` label if it's tiny.

DocsBot: automated-scan results attached — 4 hits total (3 redirects, 1 asset 403). https://internal.tools/docs-scan/1743214321

Sahil: if the PR is only frontmatter + 301 edits we can auto-merge after 1 review. @Maria add `automerge:allowed` label and @Sahil will do the review.

Jen: small reminder — if you move or rehost diagrams, update CODEOWNERS or add the owner in the PR message so the handbook team sees it.

Tariq: I'll pick up the runtime diagram rehost. I'll upload to s3://redwood-docs-assets/runtime/kv-cache/diagram.svg and post the new URL in this thread.

Tariq: uploaded, new url: https://cdn.redwood.ai/docs/runtime/kv-cache/diagram.svg — Maria, feel free to swap that in the PR.

Maria: perfect, I'll update the SVG link and replace the shortlinks. PR title: "docs(ja): fix redirects + rehost runtime diag". assigning @Sahil for review.

Alex: lovely. target: merge by tomorrow EOD. Thanks all :tada:
